description: Introducing a stylish and efficient 2014 Volkswagen Passat 2.0L TDI SE — finished in Platinum Gray Metallic with warm Beige leather seating. This diesel-powered Passat pairs Mazda-like practicality with Volkswagen refinement: the heart of the car is the 2.0L Turbocharged Diesel I4 producing 140 hp and a strong 236 lb-ft of torque, routed through a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission to the front wheels. That combination delivers outstanding fuel economy — an EPA-rated 31 MPG city and 43 MPG highway — so you can enjoy long highway runs and daily commutes without frequent stops at the pump. Factory-equipped features you’ll appreciate - Powertrain and driving: 2.0L TDI Turbo Diesel I4, 6-speed automatic transmission with Tiptronic/manual shift capability, front-wheel drive, and a well-tuned suspension that balances comfort and composed handling. Strong low-end torque makes highway passing and on-ramp acceleration effortless. - Exterior styling and convenience: Platinum Gray Metallic paint, 17-inch alloy wheels, body-colored heated side mirrors, and integrated fog lamps. Chrome accents give the profile a refined, upscale look. - Seating and interior comfort: Beige leather seating surfaces (factory leather), heated front seats, comfortably contoured front buckets, and a 60/40 split-folding rear seat for added cargo flexibility. Power-adjustable driver’s seat with lumbar support helps tailor your driving position for longer trips. - Climate and comfort controls: Dual-zone automatic climate control (Climatronic) so driver and front passenger can set independent temperatures, front and rear vents for even airflow, and convenient front and rear climate controls. - Infotainment and connectivity: Center-mounted touchscreen radio with AM/FM and CD capability, Bluetooth hands-free phone and audio streaming, USB and auxiliary inputs for portable devices, and steering-wheel-mounted audio and phone controls for safer operation on the move. - Safety and driver aids: Anti-lock brakes (ABS), Electronic Stability Control (ESC), traction control, front and side airbags with full-length side-curtain airbags, and a Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS). LATCH anchors for child seats and multiple passive safety systems are standard factory equipment. - Convenience features: Remote keyless entry and power door locks, power windows with driver’s auto-up/down, cruise control for relaxed highway driving, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, trip computer/multi-function display in the gauge cluster, and generous trunk space for luggage or groceries. Condition and ownership note This Passat is in excellent overall condition inside and out — the Platinum Gray Metallic exterior presents beautifully, and the Beige leather cabin shows with care. Mechanically sound, economical to drive, and comfortable for both daily use and longer road trips, this 2014 Passat 2.0L TDI SE is a great choice if you’re looking for a refined, fuel-efficient sedan with real-world practicality. If you’d like additional photos, a detailed equipment list, or to schedule a test drive, we’d be happy to help.

With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. The **DOHC Dual Overhead Camshaft** design enhances engine performance, allowing for higher speeds and greater power delivery, which translates to a more exhilarating driving experience. Additionally, the **Gasoline Direct Injection** system maximizes fuel efficiency while minimizing engine noise, resulting in a quieter ride.

For entertainment and comfort, the Accord LX features **Wireless Audio Streaming**, enabling you to connect your mobile device effortlessly and enjoy your favorite playlists without the hassle of tangled cords. The **Dual Zone Front HVAC Controls** further enhance passenger comfort, allowing both the driver and front passenger to set their preferred temperature settings.

Lastly, the **Ignition Immobilizer** technology offers peace of mind by preventing unauthorized vehicle starts, while **Active Noise Cancellation** helps maintain a serene cabin environment by reducing external noise.

In summary, the 2014 Honda Accord LX impresses with its blend of performance, safety, and modern conveniences, making it an outstanding choice for anyone seeking a reliable and enjoyable driving experience.

  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
